gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) and are at first or second relapse.

candidate_evidence.quote: The NKG2D CAR-T will be administrated via intracerebroventricular injection through an Ommaya catheter.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with relapsed and/or refractory glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: This is a pilot phase I study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of NKG2D CAR-T cell therapy in patients with relapsed and/or refractory glioblastoma

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous NKG2D chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy (UWNKG2D / UWN2D), intracerebroventricular

coder_notes: Registered phase NA. Only intervention is an NKG2D CAR-T cell therapy (excluded intervention type). Temozolomide is mentioned only as standard treatment to be stopped during infusion, so not listed.
